title: Roller (Sub Theory)
description: A raw, club-leaning four-on-the-floor house roller: a 909 kick locks the floor while a rolling, crushed sub bassline walks a four-chord progression underneath. Euclidean hats and clap ratchets build the tension, a chopped vowel-filtered topline drifts in and out, and the whole thing slow-burns into a sustained, dry peak before stripping back to just kick and sub.
